newsitem.title: KENYA: Stocks recover marginally at Nairobi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Stocks recover marginally at Nairobi bourse.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Thursday as share prices recovered marginally despite subdued trading, brokers said.
The index rose 8.23 points to stand at 3031.58. Turnover was posted at 7.006 million shillings on 263,043 shares compared to 7.562 million shilling on 260,112 shares on Wednesday.
A bourse official said the market was still not fully recovered as only a few share prices picked up. Most of the other counters were just holding steady.
A broker said trading was subdued. The most likely reason was that the market was still trying to find its direction.

Brokers said the trading of the 11.88 million primary shares of Kenya Commercial Bank (KCB) which begAn on Monday seemed to be undermining the market As most investors were targeting their money to purchase the bank's shares.
Kenya Commercial Bank was steady at 52.50 on 6,028 shares, National Bank of Kenya traded 35,255 shares at 16.90, 16 and 16.25 from 16.65 while Housing Finance rose to 25 from 23.75.
In commercials, CMC Holdings rose 2.0 shillings to 63, Nation Printers & Publishers gained a shilling to 106 while Kenya Airways traded 65,139 shares at 10.20 from 10.10.
Officials said foreign investors dealt 6,774 shares of Kenya Power & Lighting at 107 and 1,492 shares of Bamburi Cement at 30.
British American Tobacco fell a shilling to 69, East African Oxygen rose to 63.50 from 63 and Dunlop Kenya gained to 260 from 259.
